story_type: freefall jump out of an airplane into a lake
hook: They stepped out of the airplane over open water. On purpose.
narration: They stepped out of the airplane over open water, and they did it on purpose.
This was freefall parachute training, part of the 68th Rescue Squadron's Combat Team Member Course.
Rescue teams parachute in when there is no faster way to reach someone, and sometimes that someone is in the water.
One after another, the canopies drifted down over Theodore Roosevelt Lake in Arizona.
[short pause] Then, feet first, straight into the lake.
outcome: A boat crew raced out across the water and hauled the jumpers aboard.
title: Jumping out of a plane into a lake
description:
Freefall and static line parachute training hosted by the 68th Rescue Squadron as part of the Combat Team Member Course at Theodore Roosevelt Lake, Arizona, on July 29, 2020.
